firm_data.firm_description: Tutunjian & Bitetto, P.C. specializes in Intellectual Property law, with particular expertise in prosecuting and securing Patent and Trademark rights for the benefit of their clients. The Firm's attorneys and staff provide in-depth comprehensive technical and legal expertise attained over many years of practice.
notable_facts: Provides services to a wide range of clients, ranging from small business startups to Fortune 500 companies.
Thousands of patent, trademark and copyright filings and registrations to their name.

email.subject: AI for Tutunjian & Bitetto, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi James,

With thousands of patent and trademark filings under your belt since 2000, your team at Tutunjian & Bitetto knows exactly what precision looks like. That expertise is also your competitive advantage, and it's exactly what we help protect.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of specialized practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Northeast to meet regional IP firms. I'd be happy to stop by Melville to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping firms like yours compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
